Every model has its own Neuron price, and llama-3.3-70b costs six times more per output token than the 8b model, so that figure belongs to the model it was computed on: a tracked model gets a DERIVED figure only from its own price in neuron_cost_examples, and a tracked model whose price is not on file has an UNKNOWN daily volume rather than another model's number. Seven models are excluded from the free tier entirely and need a paid billing method. 10,000 Neurons/day / 204,805 Neurons per 1M output tokens on this model = 48,826 output tokens/day. Both figures are the provider's; the division is ours. Binding limit: Neurons per day, at 10,000. On a small text model that is roughly a quarter of a million output tokens; on a large one, far fewer. Applies per ACCOUNT.

Every model has its own Neuron price, and llama-3.3-70b costs six times more per output token than the 8b model, so that figure belongs to the model it was computed on: a tracked model gets a DERIVED figure only from its own price in neuron_cost_examples, and a tracked model whose price is not on file has an UNKNOWN daily volume rather than another model's number. Seven models are excluded from the free tier entirely and need a paid billing method. 286,795 output tokens/day is the provider-level figure, computed on another model's unit price, and is not claimed for this model. Daily volume UNKNOWN: this model's unit price is not on file. Binding limit: Neurons per day, at 10,000. On a small text model that is roughly a quarter of a million output tokens; on a large one, far fewer. Applies per ACCOUNT.

unranked.volume_evidence: Their pricing page answers what the header readings could not: the Free plan grants $10 a month in API credits.
